audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gives Ziggs levels 2, 3 and 6 at 2/10 and Skill at 4-5 and first item, while every piece of prose on the page says the opposite: whys[1] through whys[5] all describe Jax winning, mid opens 'This is your lane', and late opens 'You win the straight 1v1 all game'. Only level 1 and the late game are actually his.
audit.why: The packet chart (Ziggs, Jax, Jax, Jax, Jax, Jax, Ziggs) matches the prose and the 52.77% win rate. Once Leap Strike can bridge his range off a minion, Ziggs has no melee defence — his only peel is Satchel Charge on 20s at rank 1, against a Leap Strike that comes back every 8s and a Bouncing Bomb of his own on 6s.
audit.corrected: Rows 1 through 5 set to Jax across both layers as one atomic group, ratings raised from 2/10 and 5/10 to match. The overall difficulty was also carrying 8.5/10 and 'Hard matchup', which cannot stand next to a chart Jax wins five rows of; corrected to 5/10 in diffRating, breakdown.difficulty and report[14].t.

audit.whatIsWrong: Jax's ultimate is written "Grandmaster at Arms" in whys[4], spikes[1].text, mid and wants.you[2].
audit.why: The ability is Grandmaster's Might, 110/100/90s; phases[4].why already uses the correct name.
audit.corrected: Renamed in all four. Spike structure verified: Jax at 2-3 (gap-close online), 6 and first item; Ziggs only at level 1 and at full items where Mega Inferno Bomb (120s at rank 1, 5000 range) makes him a map problem rather than a lane one.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page correctly and repeatedly warns that Counter Strike dodges autos but does nothing to Bouncing Bomb or Hexplosive Minefield — but none of the three cooldowns that make the plan work are given anywhere.
audit.why: Bouncing Bomb is 6s at rank 1 falling to 4s, so 'go when his Q is down' is a very narrow window and shrinks as he ranks it. Satchel Charge is 20s at rank 1 — the real gap, and more than twice your Leap Strike's 8s, which is why baiting it wins the lane. Hexplosive Minefield is a flat 16s at every rank and its slow is his only hard peel, which is what actually justifies Mercury's Treads. Satchel Charge also deals percent max health, so stacking HP does not help you eat it.
audit.corrected: dosFull[0].d now carries Satchel Charge's 20s; whys[3] carries Bouncing Bomb's 6s; mid carries both plus the minefield's 16s.

audit.why: packet.defects reports 8 probable wrong ability names. All eight are false positives: 'Bouncing Bombs' and 'Leap Strikes' are plurals, 'His Bouncing Bomb', 'Once Counter Strike', 'Use Leap Strike', 'Hold Counter Strike', 'Save Satchel Charge' and 'Drop Hexplosive Minefield' are the real names with a leading word. Every name on this page matches packet.enemyAbilities.
audit.corrected: No name changes made on the flagged strings.

edits.before: This is your lane. Once Counter Strike is ranked and your Leap Strike cooldown drops, every time his Bouncing Bomb is down you Q in on a minion, E-stun, and burst him. His only out is Satchel Charge knocking himself away, so either bait it first or hold your dash until after he blows it. At 6, Grandmaster at Arms is your spike: the Armor/MR steroid shrugs off a full Bouncing Bomb + minefield rotation and turns a coinflip into a clean kill. Force the all-in here and on every roam where his Satchel is on cooldown, because off the wave he has no way to peel you.

At 6, Grandmaster's Might is your spike: the Armor/MR steroid shrugs off a full bomb-and-minefield rotation. Force the all-in here and on every roam where the Satchel is down, because his 16s minefield slow is the only peel he has left.

notes: This page had the largest chart-versus-prose split in my slice: five of seven rows said Ziggs or Skill while every prose block said Jax owns the lane from 2 to first item. I moved the chart to the prose and the packet, and also dropped the overall difficulty from 8.5/10 to 5/10 in the three places it appeared, since 'Hard matchup' cannot sit above a chart Jax wins five rows of. The tldr and winCon still frame the lane as 'he kites you out — survive', which now reads oddly against the corrected chart; they are within the length band to rewrite but I left them rather than restate the lane's identity twice in one pass. All eight of packet's flagged ability names are false positives. Satchel Charge's percent-max-health damage is in the kit and on no string — worth adding, since it is the reason HP stacking does not answer his poke.
